events.summary: Tiger Woods celebrates five years as a professional at the NEC Invitational, having won six major championships, keeping pace with Jack Nicklaus's first five years.
Tiger Woods stated he could achieve a calendar-year Grand Slam and focused on the Masters, where he aimed to win his fifth green jacket.
Tiger Woods said his willingness to reconstruct his golf swing in front of the world is proof of a continued determination to win major championships.
Tiger Woods won the 102nd US Open, reaching the halfway stage toward a possible calendar grand slam.

Tiger Woods was arrested in the early hours of Monday after being found asleep at the wheel of his damaged Mercedes, described by police as cooperative but confused, with a zero blood alcohol level and Woods attributing his condition to prescription medications.
Tiger Woods is back working with his long-time swing coach Hank Haney, who arrived in Orlando to spend the next few days working with Woods near his home at Isleworth.
Tiger Woods won the Open Championship at Hoylake, successfully defending the title and claiming his 11th major championship.
Tiger Woods will miss the Masters due to a back injury after undergoing surgery on a pinched nerve.
Tiger Woods will play at next week's WGC-CA Championship in Florida, the PGA Tour announced.
Tiger Woods says he would not be surprised to regain the world No1 spot by winning the Open on Sunday.
Tiger Woods won the 129th Open championship at St Andrews, becoming the youngest man ever to win all four of golf's grand slam tournaments.
Tiger Woods was voted athlete of the decade by the Associated Press.
Tiger Woods was injured in a car crash near his home in Windermere, Florida, and was treated for facial lacerations and released from hospital.
Tiger Woods missed the 36-hole cut at the Quicken Loans National Championship in his first competitive start since back surgery, saying he was encouraged despite the result.

Tiger Woods announced his competitive return to golf, planning to play the Safeway Open in mid-October, the Turkish Airlines Open in early November, and the Hero World Challenge in December, though he said whether he can play depends on his continued progress and recovery.

Tiger Woods said his rehabilitation from knee surgery is progressing without setbacks and he expects to return to competition in the new year, while he hosts the Chevron World Challenge in a non-playing capacity.
Tiger Woods withdrew from the Honda Classic due to back trouble and is expected to play in the WGC-Cadillac Championship.
Tiger Woods was injured in a car crash outside his Florida home and was admitted, treated, and released from hospital in good condition.
Tiger Woods announced he is taking a break from the US PGA Tour, saying his game is not acceptable for tournament golf, and will not return until he is ready.
Tiger Woods said he is making progress in his recovery from back surgery but still does not have a date in mind for his return to tournament golf.
Tiger Woods underwent back surgery for the second time in two years and will miss the rest of the 2015 season.

PGA Tour commissioner Tim Finchem discussed the inevitability of Tiger Woods eventually stepping away permanently from top-level golf, saying he does not know when Woods might return from his latest absence due to injury and form.
Tiger Woods announced he is taking an indefinite break from professional golf amid allegations about his private life and admitted infidelity.
